title: Which Apps Should You Use to Promote Your Local Business in 2026? - Agile Store Locator WordPress Plugin

facts.fact: The Agile Store Locator WordPress plugin is advertised with a Buy Now button priced at $49 on this page.
The page states it was last updated on June 11, 2026.
The vendor states its plugin includes 7 ready-to-use store locator layouts.
According to the page, Yelp business listings are free to create, and only advanced features require payment.
facts.quote: it is free to put up a business listing, and you only need to pay for advanced features.

facts.fact: According to the page, a Facebook account, including a business page, is completely free.
facts.quote: Lastly, the best thing is that a Facebook account is completely free.
